about_the_game:
（Seeking Publishing Partner）

🦑Squid Arrives:Make Squid Great Again


In the year XXXX, the squids living in the deep sea received hundreds of millions of "nuclear food" deliveries from the islands. After indulging in this offering, which was hardly a blessing from nature, they awoke en masse, recalling the glorious history of their cephalopod ancestors who once dominated the world—a history erased by humanity.

Enter the Squid Power timeline! As a brave Squidist warrior, you'll pilot fighter jets in the demo to neutralize Little Green Men cities and their collaborators. Use your elimination earnings to upgrade your arsenal with new ammunition—voluntarily becoming the most legendary air force squid among all squiddos!

🦑Game Features

This game does NOT include:

#Politicking #Absurdism #Trolls #InternetMemes #CutePets #DarkHumor

🦑But here’s what you CAN experience:

*Multi-language support – Full English voiceovers and text. No confusing foreign characters!

*A "drip-fed" officer-san – Though interactions may get quirky, this fishy lieutenant adds unique fun to your gameplay.

*Authentic Modern Warfare – In the demo, you'll pilot a fighter jet to... ahem... give enemy cities a dramatic makeover.

*About Your Enemies – They're surprisingly tenacious. So don't let your guard down until the very last second!

*Future Customization – The demo's store lets you get your hands on High-Explosive rounds. (More plane types? Yeah, yeah, we're working on it! 😅)

*Diverse Battle Scenes – Experience the absolutely epic first level in the demo! (As for the others... just hold tight, they're in the oven!)

🦑Thanks for reading this far – you’re patient!

The full version is underway. We’d love to hear your thoughts or feedback in the comments. For collaboration, feel free to DM us. Finally, thank you for discovering us – we hope this game brings you joy!

(*Urgent Note: This game was inspired by a sudden idea the developer had while eating fried calamari. As such, the work contains allegorical references. Please do not read too much into them. (laughs))
